meta.title: Butler (dsh-butler)
meta.description: A butler for DeepSeek Harness: a cross-workspace overview of every session, task board and schedule, with proactive notifications when a turn finishes, plus 13 built-in IM channels (WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, QQ, Slack, Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp, iMessage, Matrix, email, AI Office).
